In-use utensil stored in standing water less than 135 degrees Fahrenheit.

chicken gravy (45-46F - Cooling)
Made yesterday, in walk in cooler overnight

Dishmachine chlorine sanitizer not at proper minimum strength. Discontinue use of dishmachine for sanitizing and set up manual sanitization until dishmachine is repaired and sanitizing properly.
Bar glass machine reading 0ppm

Raw animal food stored over/not properly separated from ready-to-eat food.
Raw shrimp over cooked pasta

Stop Sale issued on time/temperature control for safety food due to temperature abuse.
Chef discarded

Handwash sink not accessible for employee use at all times.
Dish racks in front of hand sink in dish area. Employee moved

Dishmachine not washing/rinsing properly. Must wash, rinse and sanitize all dishware, equipment and utensils in three-compartment sink until dishmachine is functioning properly.

Equipment and utensils not properly air-dried - wet nesting.

Food storage container/container lid cracked or broken.
Bulk bin lids have cracks

Food-contact surface not smooth and easily cleanable.
Small bamboo steamers in walk in. Provided education

Stored food not covered.
Spice mix in prep area. Employee covered

Silverware stored upright with the food-contact surface up.
Butter knives in basket
Clam tags not marked with last date served. Educated operator

House made Salsa
